title: Vibrant Buttery French Vegetables Ratatouille
description: A classic French dish from the Alsace region, this ratatouille is made with buttery vegetables and features a cheese pull, energizing flavors, and anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients, all tied together with an egg wash and mortar-pestle-pounded spices.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a mortar and pestle, pound the garlic and thyme until well combined.
In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat and add the sliced eggplant, cooking until browned on both sides and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter and cook the sliced zucchini and bell peppers until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onions to the skillet and cook until they are translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the pounded garlic and thyme, and the cooked vegetables.

In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of the vegetable mixture, followed by a sprinkle of shredded gruyere cheese, and repeat this process until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Brush the egg wash over the top layer of cheese to create a golden brown crust.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake the ratatouille in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
